-- | A Haskell-to-Verilog/VHDL compiler, front end (GHC driver, Eidos, Synolon)
--   
--   The ReWire front end. The GHC driver and Core-to-Eidos bridge
--   (ReWire.GHC.*), the Eidos typed functional IR and its passes
--   (ReWire.Eidos.*), the Synolon machine-level IR, purification, and the
--   Synolon-to-Hyle fold (ReWire.Synolon.*), and the pass-pipeline
--   orchestration. Produces a ReWire.Hyle device; depends on
--   rewire-backend for the Hyle IR and RTL backends and on rewire-base for
--   shared utilities.
@package rewire-frontend
@version 2.8

-- | The shared naming and ordering conventions for compiler-minted
--   definitions and machine-level labels: one function per naming
--   decision, so independently-minted artifacts that must correspond
--   (purify's block labels; the join continuations the machine fold lifts)
--   agree by construction, and regenerated goldens drift minimally.
--   
--   Names are <i>occurrence-stable</i>: derived from the enclosing
--   definition's display name, the bound occurrence's display name, and a
--   deterministic per-name ordinal — never from a global fresh counter,
--   which renumbers wholesale on any upstream change.
module ReWire.Eidos.Naming

-- | The top-level name for a join continuation lifted out of a definition:
--   <tt>$LL.&lt;defn&gt;.&lt;join&gt;&lt;ordinal&gt;</tt>. The
--   <tt>$LL.</tt> prefix marks the definition as compiler-lifted; it is
--   display-only (the machine fold strips it via <a>defnBase</a> when
--   naming the Hyle definition).
liftedJoinName :: Text -> Text -> Int -> Text

-- | The label for a purify-minted block: <tt>$L.&lt;source&gt;</tt> for a
--   source name's first block, <tt>$L.&lt;source&gt;&lt;ordinal&gt;</tt>
--   from the second on. The ordinal is per source name, so an upstream
--   edit renumbers only that name's later blocks, never the whole process.
--   (The machine fold derives the blocks' Hyle definition names from these
--   via <a>labelBase</a>, disambiguating collisions there; dispatch order
--   and tag values key on the label's unique, not its text.)
blockLabel :: Text -> Int -> Text

-- | The display base of a machine-label occurrence, for naming the block's
--   Hyle definition: label prefixes and qualification stripped, the
--   per-name ordinal kept (<tt>$L.Main.getIns2</tt> -&gt;
--   <tt>getIns2</tt>, <tt>$L.arm</tt> -&gt; <tt>arm</tt>, <tt>$L.$ds</tt>
--   -&gt; <tt>$ds</tt> — compiler-marked binders stay marked).
labelBase :: Text -> Text

-- | The display base of a top-level definition's occurrence for its Hyle
--   global name: the <tt>$LL.</tt> lifted-definition marker stripped
--   (<tt>$LL.Main.foo.j1</tt> -&gt; <tt>Main.foo.j1</tt>), other
--   occurrences unchanged.
defnBase :: Text -> Text

-- | A short display tag for an instantiation, from the pre-rendered
--   argument texts: sanitized to identifier characters (separators
--   collapse to <tt>_</tt>) and <tt>$</tt>-joined when short — <tt>Vec 8
--   Bool</tt> becomes <tt>Vec_8_Bool</tt> — otherwise a stable 32-bit
--   FNV-1a hash of the full rendering. Stability across platforms and
--   compiler versions is the point: instance names derived from these must
--   not churn between compiles (which is why this is not <a>hash</a>).
originTag :: [Text] -> Text


-- | The abstract syntax of Eidos, the typed functional IR between GHC Core
--   and the machine level (a system-F-lite mirror of GHC Core, specified
--   in doc/eidos.md). The machine level's process calculus lives in
--   <a>ReWire.Synolon.Syntax</a>, which embeds these expression types.
--   Conventions the rest of the compiler relies on:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li>Binders are globally unique (<a>Uniq</a>): every binding site in a
--   program carries a distinct unique, established by the bridge and
--   preserved by every pass (duplication goes through a refreshing clone).
--   <a>Id</a> equality and hashing are by unique only.</li>
--   <li>Types are plain data (no binders): <a>Ty</a> has no forall;
--   quantification appears only in <a>Sig</a>, as a plain type-variable
--   list. Every binder carries its full signature, so <tt>typeOf</tt> is
--   total and synthesizing.</li>
--   <li>There is no term equality instance: comparing terms for alpha
--   equivalence is an explicit operation — canonical renumbering, as in
--   ReWire.Eidos.Simplify's canonKey (through <a>refreshExp</a>) and
--   ReWire.Eidos.ProcOpt's blockKey (its own dense renumbering) — never
--   accidental structural comparison (which would be annotation- and
--   unique-sensitive).</li>
--   <li>Annotations (<a>Annote</a>) are semantically inert and never
--   compared.</li>
--   </ul>
module ReWire.Eidos.Syntax

-- | Binder uniques. Globally unique per program by construction (bridge)
--   and by maintenance (every duplicating pass refreshes them).
type Uniq = Int

-- | Type constructor and data constructor names are stable global text
--   (dotted, never shadowed); they carry no uniques.
type TyConId = Text
type DataConId = Text
data Kind
KStar :: Kind
KNat :: Kind
KFun :: !Kind -> !Kind -> Kind

-- | A type variable: display text, unique, kind. Equality and hashing by
--   unique only.
data TyVar
TyVar :: !Text -> !Uniq -> !Kind -> TyVar
[tvOcc] :: TyVar -> !Text
[tvUniq] :: TyVar -> !Uniq
[tvKind] :: TyVar -> !Kind

-- | Types: plain first-order data, no binders, no forall. Type-level
--   naturals appear literally (<a>TyNat</a>) or as applications of the
--   built-in arithmetic type constructors (see
--   ReWire.Eidos.Types.natNorm). Annotations are inert; the
--   Eq/Ord/Hashable instances ignore them.
data Ty
TyCon :: Annote -> !TyConId -> Ty
TyApp :: Annote -> !Ty -> !Ty -> Ty
TyVarT :: Annote -> !TyVar -> Ty
TyNat :: Annote -> !Natural -> Ty
Arrow :: Annote -> !Ty -> !Ty -> Ty

-- | A signature: quantified type variables (empty for every local binder;
--   possibly non-empty for top-level definitions, constructors, and
--   primitive references) over a forall-free type.
data Sig
Sig :: ![TyVar] -> !Ty -> Sig
[sigTVs] :: Sig -> ![TyVar]
[sigTy] :: Sig -> !Ty

-- | A monomorphic signature.
monoSig :: Ty -> Sig

-- | A term-level name: display text, unique, signature. Locals always have
--   monomorphic signatures (<a>monoSig</a>); top-level definition names
--   may be polymorphic until specialization. Equality and hashing by
--   unique only.
data Id
Id :: !Text -> !Uniq -> !Sig -> Id
[idOcc] :: Id -> !Text
[idUniq] :: Id -> !Uniq
[idSig] :: Id -> !Sig

-- | A join point name: an <a>Id</a> plus the number of value parameters
--   every <a>Jump</a> to it must supply (jumps are saturated).
data JoinId
JoinId :: !Id -> !Int -> JoinId
[jpId] :: JoinId -> !Id
[jpArity] :: JoinId -> !Int

-- | Expressions. Type occurrences: <a>Var</a> reads its type off the
--   <a>Id</a> signature; <a>Con</a>, <a>Prim</a>, and the literals carry
--   their (instantiated) type at the occurrence; everything else
--   synthesizes (see ReWire.Eidos.Types.typeOf).
data Exp
Var :: Annote -> !Id -> Exp
Con :: Annote -> !Ty -> !DataConId -> Exp
Prim :: Annote -> !Ty -> !Builtin -> Exp
LitInt :: Annote -> !Ty -> !Integer -> Exp
LitStr :: Annote -> !Text -> Exp
LitList :: Annote -> !Ty -> ![Exp] -> Exp
LitVec :: Annote -> !Ty -> ![Exp] -> Exp
App :: Annote -> !Exp -> !Arg -> Exp
Lam :: Annote -> !Id -> !Exp -> Exp
Let :: Annote -> !Bind -> !Exp -> Exp
Jump :: Annote -> !JoinId -> ![Exp] -> Exp
Case :: Annote -> !Ty -> !Exp -> !Id -> ![Alt] -> Exp

-- | An application argument: a term or a type. Type arguments instantiate
--   the head's signature variables in order; the specializer is driven by
--   them.
data Arg
EArg :: !Exp -> Arg
TArg :: !Ty -> Arg

-- | Local bindings. <a>Join</a> declares a join point whose body ends the
--   enclosing scope's continuation (<a>Jump</a> is the only way to reach
--   it); the parameter list length must equal the <a>JoinId</a> arity.
data Bind
NonRec :: !Id -> !Exp -> Bind
Rec :: ![(Id, Exp)] -> Bind
Join :: !JoinId -> ![Id] -> !Exp -> Bind

-- | Case alternatives. The default alternative, if present, comes first
--   (the Core convention); constructor alternatives bind their fields.
data Alt
Alt :: Annote -> !AltCon -> ![Id] -> !Exp -> Alt
data AltCon
DataAlt :: !DataConId -> AltCon
LitAlt :: !Integer -> AltCon
DefaultAlt :: AltCon

-- | A top-level definition: name (whose signature is the definition's
--   signature), a parameter telescope (arity is structural: length matches
--   the signature's arrow spine prefix), and a body.
data Defn
Defn :: Annote -> !Id -> ![Id] -> !Exp -> !Maybe DefnAttr -> !Maybe SpecOrigin -> Defn
[defnAnnote] :: Defn -> Annote
[defnId] :: Defn -> !Id
[defnParams] :: Defn -> ![Id]
[defnBody] :: Defn -> !Exp
[defnAttr] :: Defn -> !Maybe DefnAttr
[defnOrigin] :: Defn -> !Maybe SpecOrigin
data DefnAttr
Inline :: DefnAttr
NoInline :: DefnAttr

-- | Provenance of a compiler-minted definition clone: the origin
--   definition's display name and — for specializer clones — the type
--   arguments it was instantiated at (<a>BakeOrigin</a> marks the partial
--   evaluator's value-baked clones, whose baked arguments are terms, not
--   types). Rides into dumps, error messages, and (stably) generated HDL
--   names.
data SpecOrigin
SpecOrigin :: !Text -> ![Ty] -> SpecOrigin
[originName] :: SpecOrigin -> !Text
[originArgs] :: SpecOrigin -> ![Ty]
BakeOrigin :: !Text -> SpecOrigin

-- | A datatype declaration. Constructor signatures quantify the datatype's
--   parameters: <tt>C :: forall as. t1 -&gt; ... -&gt; tk -&gt; T as</tt>.
data DataDefn
DataDefn :: Annote -> !TyConId -> !Kind -> ![DataCon] -> DataDefn
[dataAnnote] :: DataDefn -> Annote
[dataName] :: DataDefn -> !TyConId
[dataKind] :: DataDefn -> !Kind
[dataCons] :: DataDefn -> ![DataCon]
data DataCon
DataCon :: Annote -> !DataConId -> !Sig -> DataCon

-- | A whole program: datatypes, definitions, and the designated device
--   root.
data Program
Program :: ![DataDefn] -> ![Defn] -> !Id -> Program
[progDatas] :: Program -> ![DataDefn]
[progDefns] :: Program -> ![Defn]
[progTop] :: Program -> !Id
instance ReWire.Annotation.Annotated ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Exp
instance ReWire.Annotation.Annotated ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Ty
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Alt
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.AltCon
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Arg
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Bind
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.DataCon
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.DataDefn
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Defn
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.DefnAttr
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Exp
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Id
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.JoinId
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Kind
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Program
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Sig
instance GHC.Internal.Data.Data.Data ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.SpecOrigin

instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Program
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Sig

instance Data.Hashable.Class.Hashable ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.AltCon

instance Control.DeepSeq.NFData ReWire.Eidos.Syntax.Alt
